factory.name: Toaster.create
factory.signature: Toaster.create(options?: ToasterOptions, doc?: Document): Toaster; toast(options: ToastOptions, doc?: Document): ToastHandle

options.name: position
options.description: Region corner (logical: end is right in LTR, left in RTL).

options.name: max
options.description: Maximum visible toasts (1..20); further toasts queue first-in, first-out.

options.name: duration
options.description: Auto-dismiss delay in ms (0 = persistent). Error toasts persist unless given a duration. Applies to toasts shown afterwards.

options.name: hotkey
options.description: Moves focus to the newest toast; null disables.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the region label, tone prefixes, and dismiss label.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The region <section>; aui-open and aui-close fire here.

properties.name: queued
properties.description: Toasts waiting for a free slot.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Show (or queue) a toast { tone?, title?, message, duration?, action? }. Returns { id, dismiss(), update() }.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Dismiss all visible toasts and drop the queue.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove the region, timers, listeners, and subscriptions (no events).

methods.name: ToastHandle.dismiss
methods.description: Close the toast (reason programmatic) or drop it from the queue.

methods.name: ToastHandle.update
methods.description: Merge options; a visible toast is re-announced and its timer restarts.

methods.name: toast
methods.description: Show a toast in a lazily created default Toaster for the document.

events.name: aui-open
events.description: A toast became visible (fired on the region).

events.name: aui-close
events.description: A visible toast closed (fired on the region).

cssClasses.name: aui-toast__text
cssClasses.description: Tone prefix, title, and message; labels the toast.
